description: Rent vs buy calculator — Rent or buy a home? Month-by-month net-worth simulation over years= (default 7): mortgage, property tax, insurance, HOA, maintenance, PMI under 20% down, appreciation, rent increases, buying/selling costs and the opportunity cost of the down payment invested at invest_return. Returns both net worths, verdict BUY / RENT / TOSS-UP, break-even rent, break-even year and a yearly table. Required: price=, rent= (monthly). Optional: years, down (%), rate, term, property_tax (%), insurance ($/yr), hoa ($/mo), maintenance (%), appreciation, rent_increase, invest_return, closing_buy, selling_cost, pmi (all %). Offline math. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: finance_rent_vs_buy
